name: Pop's Cafe Hanceville
summary: A 1950s style diner with chrome counters and checkered floors. Regulars rave about the fluffy pancakes, and meatloaf is on the menu every day. Fresh cakes are baked daily, with German chocolate the crowd favorite.

name: Country Wok
summary: The owner trained at a culinary school in New York and is known for eggrolls, Korean fried wings and Grandma's Cantonese fried rice. The kitchen is open so you can watch your food being made.

name: Hanceville Drug Co Soda Fountain
summary: An old fashioned soda fountain inside a pharmacy that has served the town since 1916. Scoops, sundaes, floats, shakes and the famous cherry ice await.

name: Dodge City Restaurant
summary: Tucked inside the Dodge City Travel Center, this spot is a favorite of locals and truck drivers, who swear by its fried cheeseburger.

name: Coffee Hour Co.
summary: A husband and wife coffee roastery downtown that opened its walk in tasting room in February 2025. Try a flight of coffees from around the world, just like a wine tasting but with more pep.
address: Commercial Street, beside Hanceville Drug Co.

name: Meatloaf Every Day at Pop's
summary: Pop's Cafe says meatloaf is served every day, with chicken and dumplings, dressing and vegetable soup rotating through the week. You can even call to request a dish.

name: Azul Tequila Mexican Cantina
summary: Listed by the City of Hanceville as a local place to eat. Stop by and tell them we sent you!
